eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Summit, UT; at 7:59 PM on AUG 8, 2026 Effective until 8:59 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Hog Back Summit has been placed in a 'Ready' Status to plan for possible evacuation due to the Rocky Canyon Fire. Be prepared to evacuate. Please gather important documents, medicines, and an evacuation bag; prepare your vehicles and animals. Further information to come. Please do not call 911 for updates.
